# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi
# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
"""Archive closed capture qualification, preserve outcomes, retire duplicates."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree')
W = G / 'feat-phase-gated-quality-capture-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-phase-gated-quality-capture'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('capture_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def safe(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: safe(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [safe(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(safe(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-phase-gated-quality-publication-root-v3'
    assert not out.exists() and F.is_dir()
    prior_failure_path = B / 'main-phase-gated-quality-publication-root-v1/record.json'
    prior_failure = load(prior_failure_path)
    assert not prior_failure['active'] and not prior_failure['passed'] and prior_failure['error'] == "AssertionError('report-lints')"
    assert all(m.closed(c) for c in prior_failure['commands'])
    names = ['main-phase-gated-quality-full-build-root-v1',
             'main-phase-gated-quality-full-lints-root-v1',
             'main-phase-gated-quality-first-row-root-v1']
    receipts = {name: load(B / name / 'record.json') for name in names}
    assert all(x['passed'] and x['complete'] and not x['active'] for x in receipts.values())
    assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for x in receipts.values() for c in x['commands'])
    build, lint, actual = [receipts[name] for name in names]
    assert lint['lints_qualified'] and not lint['novel_findings']
    assert actual['actual_first_row_capture_qualified'] and actual['full_vocabulary_capture']
    assert build['source_pins'] == lint['source_pins'] == actual['source_pins']
    assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
    assert actual['binary_sha256'] == build['free']['binary_sha256']
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], evidence={}, main_reviewed=True,
             performance_samples=[], adopted=False, gpu_executed=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = dict(build['environment'])
    env.update(GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes')

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('CAPTURE PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
                            rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '6035c4f92bf87362d7e55051ae1375b9befba89e'
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        dirty = run('dirty', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only']).splitlines()
        new = run('new', ['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).splitlines()
        assert {name for name in dirty + new if not name.startswith(str(F.relative_to(W)) + '/')} == set(build['source_pins'])
        F.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        previous_preflight = B / 'main-phase-gated-quality-publication-root-v2/record.json'
        previous_record = load(previous_preflight)
        assert not previous_record['active'] and not previous_record['passed'] and previous_record['error'] == 'AssertionError()'
        dump(F / 'second-publication-preflight-failure.json',dict(original_path=str(previous_preflight),sha256=m.sha(previous_preflight),record=previous_record,
            main_review='Retry included owned alreadygenerated reportfiles in source-dirty check; filter only thisreportpath after exactfivesourcepins verification. Originalfailedstatus preserved'))
        deletions = []
        old_archive = F / 'controllers/main-phase-gated-quality-publication-v1.py.json'
        original_controller = B / 'main-phase-gated-quality-publication-v1.py'
        assert load(old_archive)['text'] == original_controller.read_text()
        retired_archive = dict(path=str(old_archive),bytes=old_archive.stat().st_size,sha256=m.sha(old_archive),
            replacement=str(original_controller),reason='Duplicate first publication controller; original unchanged outsideGit. English phrase falsely matches generic-api-key rule; corrected controller archived')
        old_archive.unlink()
        dump(F / 'original-publication-failure.json',dict(original_path=str(prior_failure_path),sha256=m.sha(prior_failure_path),
            record=prior_failure, original_controller_sha256=m.sha(original_controller),
            main_review='generic-api-key matched ordinaryEnglish prose in REPORT.md and its controller copy; nosecret. Preserve failedpublicationstatus; onlyEnglishwordingcorrected, no checkdisabled'))
        pins = {}
        for name, receipt in receipts.items():
            original = B / name / 'record.json'
            pins[str(original)] = m.sha(original)
            compact = {k: v for k, v in receipt.items() if k != 'evidence'}
            compact['evidence'] = {}
            for label, evidence in receipt.get('evidence', {}).items():
                if label == 'engine-phase-lifetime':
                    lines = [line for line in evidence['stderr'].splitlines() if re.search(
                        r'phase-|head-lease|prefill scratch alias|prefill gated alias|serve-first-row|'
                        r'prompt start|prompt end|queue-completed|FAILED|ZE_RESULT_ERROR|ERROR', line)]
                    compact['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=evidence['stdout'], selected_stderr=lines)
                elif label.startswith('kernel') and '-cursor' not in label:
                    compact['evidence'][label] = dict(summary='Kernel cursors/filter/relevant entries and fault outcomes retained in kernel_checks')
                elif 'lint' in label or label.startswith(('configure-', 'build-')):
                    compact['evidence'][label] = dict(summary='Commands/environment/source/binary identities and complete findings or test outcomes retained; repeated successful text retired')
                else:
                    compact['evidence'][label] = evidence
            target = F / 'receipts' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, dict(original_path=str(original), original_sha256=m.sha(original), record=compact))
            for command in receipt['commands']:
                for kind in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
                    path = B / name / 'commands' / (command['label'] + '.' + kind)
                    if not path.exists():
                        continue
                    sha = command['logs'][path.name]['sha256']
                    assert m.sha(path) == sha
                    assert receipt['evidence'][command['label']][kind] == path.read_text()
                    deletions.append(dict(path=str(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size, sha256=sha,
                        replacement=str(target), reason='Closed duplicate; original immutable receipt retains exact bytes, compact committed receipt retains useful evidence'))
        research_names = [
            'research-layer-major-current-lifetime-round396-v1.txt',
            'research-layer-major-kv-capacity-round397-v1.txt',
            'research-layer-major-streamed-existing-path-round398-v1.txt',
            'research-layer-major-compact-workspace-parity-round399-v1.txt',
            'research-layer-major-transfer-schedule-round400-v1.txt',
            'research-decode-hardware-roofline-round401-v1.txt',
            'implementation-restore-layer-major-prefill-v1.txt',
            'implementation-restore-layer-major-prefill-v2.txt',
            'implementation-bounded-decode-route-ledger-v1.txt',
            'implementation-bounded-decode-route-ledger-v2.txt']
        reports = []
        for name in research_names:
            original = B / 'research-20261009' / name
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, dict(path=str(original), sha256=m.sha(original), text=original.read_text()))
            reports.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        prior = G / 'feat-strata-upstream-sync-skill-20261013/bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-sync-skill-and-regression-audit/report-registry-v193.json'
        assert load(prior)['research_completed'] == 948
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v194.json', dict(research_completed=958,
            prior=dict(path=str(prior), git_revision='97f8b40ca99ec298c24d7ecc7b270e530d43194d', sha256=m.sha(prior)),
            new_reports=reports, main_only_test_execution=True,
            main_corrections='R398 refines R397: existing perchunk staged KV can support one-layer traversal; persistent owner needed only for crosschunk stage reuse optimization. R401 clean128 GEN performance proposal is superseded by user-required unchanged upstream bench.sh; GEN/timer counters remain diagnostic only.'))
        controllers = ['main-phase-gated-quality-full-build-v1.py', 'main-phase-gated-quality-full-lints-v1.py',
                       'main-phase-gated-quality-first-row-v1.py', 'main-phase-gated-quality-publication-v3.py']
        for name in controllers:
            original = B / name
            dump(F / 'controllers' / (name + '.json'), dict(path=str(original), sha256=m.sha(original), text=original.read_text()))
        captures = actual['captures']
        for capture in captures:
            assert m.sha(capture['path']) == capture['sha256']
        for index in (1, 2):
            partial = B / names[-1] / 'captures' / f'request-{index}.partial'
            final = B / names[-1] / 'captures' / f'request-{index}.bin'
            assert partial.stat().st_ino == final.stat().st_ino
            deletions.append(dict(path=str(partial), bytes=partial.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(partial),
                replacement=str(final), reason='Successful hardlink publication verified; final named capture remains'))
        short = Path(captures[0]['path'])
        deletions.append(dict(path=str(short), bytes=short.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(short),
            replacement=str(F / 'summary.json'), reason='Short-input producer/lifecycle evidence complete; no numerical comparison consumes this row. Keep only32K reference'))
        dump(F / 'summary.json', dict(source_parent='6035c4f92bf87362d7e55051ae1375b9befba89e',
            source_pins=build['source_pins'], free=build['free'], contrib_llvm=build['contrib-llvm'],
            cpu_release=build['phase-host'], asan_ubsan=build['phase-host-asan'],
            actual_parent_lints_qualified=True, novel_findings=[], actual_requests=actual['requests'],
            captures=captures, normal_quit=actual['normal_quit'], kernel_checks=actual['kernel_checks'],
            actual_first_row_capture_qualified=True, model_quality_qualified=False,
            teacher_forced_sequence_producer_registered=False, full_physical262144_qualified=False,
            performance_samples=[], performance_eligible=False, adopted=False,
            default_phase_cache=0, default_gated_alias=0, default_first_row_capture=0,
            performance_method='Unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs3 only; diagnostic GEN not a speed comparison',
            registry_count=958, main_corrections='R398/R397 staging distinction; do not execute R401 GEN128 as new speed benchmark',
            next_step='Real stock streamed/serve layermajor restoration; producer registration and fixed-history numerical comparison before adoption'))
        ja = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# 実サーバーの最初の logit 取得

free・contrib-llvm の全ビルド、CPU Release と ASan/UBSan、サーバーの phase lifetime
検査が通りました。変更した 5 ファイルを実際の親 6035c4f と照合し、新規 lint 指摘はゼロです。

B570 10 GiB / Ryzen 5600X / 128 GiB RAM で、fresh 1024・32768 token、出力各 1 token、
8192 chunk の実サーバーを確認しました。phase/head lease/scratch/gated を使い、全語彙
248320 の有限 FP32 logit を取得しました。予測位置は P-1、実際の T=1、reuse=0 です。
取得した argmax と出力 token は一致し、通常 QUIT、前後の GPU 確認、モデル・provider
ハッシュ、障害検査が通りました。これは producer と lifecycle の確認であり、固定履歴の
分布同等性、NLL、全物理 262144、RESTORE、速度向上を証明しません。既定 OFF を維持します。

R396–R401 と復元試作・decode 集計の v1/v2 を registry v194 に記録しました。件数は 958 です。
R398 により、既存の chunk ごとの KV stage seed を保持する層順序変更と、stage を保持して
再転送を省く最適化を区別しました。R401 の GEN128 速度比較提案は採用せず、速度比較は
変更していない上流 bench.sh に統一します。調査エージェントの提案は実測結果ではありません。

32K logit のみを次の実 producer 登録・数値比較の入力として Git 外に残します。
完了した短文 tensor、partial の別名、重複 command ログは manifest の hash を確認して削除し、
個別結果と元の結果の status は保持します。次は通常 serve と streamed KV を扱える
layer-major 実装の検証を進めます。
'''
        en = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Actual serve first-row logit capture

Full free/contrib-llvm builds, CPU Release and ASan/UBSan, and server phase lifetime
checks passed. All five changed files were compared with actual parent6035c4f;
there were no new lint findings.

On B57010GiB / Ryzen5600X /128GiB RAM, fresh1024/32768-token requests each produced
one token with8192 chunks and phase/head lease/scratch/gated enabled. Both captured
finite FP32 logits for all248320 vocabulary entries at P-1, actual T=1 and reuse=0.
Argmax matched the emitted ID. The engine closed normally. GPU checks before/after execution,
model/provider hashes and fault checks passed. This qualifies the producer and
lifecycle only, not fixed-history distribution equality,NLL,full physical262144,
RESTORE or speed. Default OFF remains.

Registry v194 archives R396–R401 and restoration/route-ledger prototypes v1/v2, totaling958 reports.
R398 distinguishes retaining existing perchunk KV stage seed from optional persistent
stage reuse. Main rejects R401's GEN128 speed-comparison proposal: only unchanged
upstream bench.sh supplies new speed comparisons. Research proposals are not measurements.

Retain only the32K logit outside Git for actual producer registration and numerical
comparison. Retire completed short tensors, partial aliases and duplicate command
logs after manifest hash checks; preserve individual outcomes and original statuses.
Next qualify layer-major support for ordinary serve and streamed KV.
'''
        (F / 'REPORT.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F / 'REPORT.md').write_text(en)
        manifest = dict(deleted=False, owner='Main', deletions=deletions,
            retained_captures=[captures[1]], early_retired_duplicates=[retired_archive], byte_budget=2 << 20,
            consumer='Actual serve producer registration and fixed-history paired numerical comparison',
            next_review='When producer integration/paired comparison supersedes reference row',
            original_pinned_receipts_retained=True, active_runs_touched=False)
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', manifest)
        files = [str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        output = run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        assert 'skipped (' not in output
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        assert all(m.sha(path) == sha for path, sha in pins.items())
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
        for deletion in deletions:
            assert m.sha(deletion['path']) == deletion['sha256']
        for deletion in deletions:
            Path(deletion['path']).unlink()
        manifest.update(deleted=True, removed_files=len(deletions),
                        removed_logical_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in deletions))
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', manifest)
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', *build['source_pins'], str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'feat(xe): qualify bounded full-vocabulary serve logit capture'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'feat/phase-gated-quality-capture-20261013'])
        assert not run('status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, removed_files=len(deletions),
                 removed_logical_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in deletions))
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'complete', 'error', 'commit']}), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
